title: Demon Lord, Retry!
description: Akira Oono awakens in the body of his online character: Demon Lord Hakuto Kunai. With powerful game mechanics and abilities on his side, this gamer turned badass plots his course through a new world filled with saints, demons, and charming companions!

episodes.title: S1-E9Dancing Swindler and the Giant Gold Coin

episodes_data.title: Demon Lord, Retry! Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Akira Onno ends up in another world of his own creation where he runs into a filthy girl shunned from her village who ends up calling him Demon Lord.

episodes_data.title: Demon Lord, Retry! Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: When one of the three Holy Maidens comes to dispatch the Demon Lord, Kunai is forced to resort to some old-fashioned discipline.

episodes_data.title: Demon Lord, Retry! Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Luna's wild sister comes to take her away. But when trouble shows up to ruin everything, a new face comes to save the day.

episodes_data.title: Demon Lord, Retry! Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Kunai summons one of his underlings who lends Aku a helping hand. But being who it is, they may end up being more than he can handle.

episodes_data.title: Demon Lord, Retry! Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: On their way to the Holy Capital, the party runs into a small village with big problems and decides to take matters into their own hands.

episodes_data.title: Demon Lord, Retry! Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: While having a pleasant dinner banquet for Aku in the Holy Capital, the celebration is cut short by a dangerous cult with a thirst for blood.

episodes_data.title: Demon Lord, Retry! Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: As the Holy Castle comes under attack, the defenders get in over their heads. Kunai opts to send his replacement to take on the troublesome Demon.

episodes_data.title: Demon Lord, Retry! Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: After investigating the Seraph in the Holy Capital, Kunai and crew jump back to Rabby Village to get his money-making scheme underway.

episodes_data.title: Demon Lord, Retry! Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: In order to prepare the hot spring resort for business, Kunai earns some much-needed funds by taking advantage of a merchant who doesn't know any better.

episodes_data.title: Demon Lord, Retry! Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Luna tries to impress Madam Shrimpfry with a tour of the hot spring resort. Later on, Aku, Luna, Yu, and Tron all compete for Kunai's attention.

episodes_data.title: Demon Lord, Retry! Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Kunai falls victim to Yukikaze's attack while on the hunt for information. Meanwhile, Angel takes it upon herself to rescue her little sister.

episodes_data.title: Demon Lord, Retry! Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: During a surprise confrontation in the outdoor bath, Angel White finds out Kunai may be more than meets the eye.

episodes_data.title: Demon Lord, Retry! Season 2 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Akira Oono was a game dev who wanted to build his own world, free from corporate oversight. But he had no idea that he'd get dragged into his own creation as Hakuto Kunai, the Demon Lord of the Great Empire! His adventure picks up where it left off!

episodes_data.title: Demon Lord, Retry! Season 2 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Akira and Kunai reflect on how far the village of Rabby has come, and the prosperity lying ahead of it.

episodes_data.title: Demon Lord, Retry! Season 2 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Kunai heads to the town of Rookie to farm for magical items in the Prison Labyrinth there. He's accompanied by Mikan and Yukikaze, and sparks are sure to fly.

episodes_data.title: Demon Lord, Retry! Season 2 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: News of Kunai's exploits reaches other nations around the world. How will they respond?

episodes_data.title: Demon Lord, Retry! Season 2 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Eagle reminisces on her life after being separated from Luna as the situation with her comes to a head. Meanwhile, Kunai gets a surprise visitor with an equally surprising request.

episodes_data.title: Demon Lord, Retry! Season 2 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Tensions flare up in Xenovia and their neighboring state of Parma as Kunai and gang continue their exploration of Beastkin territory.

episodes_data.title: Demon Lord, Retry! Season 2 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Kunai and Organ discuss their plans for their attack of Belphegor's castle, while Akane and Mink run off to make their own inroads.

episodes_data.title: Demon Lord, Retry! Season 2 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Kunai and Organ begin their attack on Belphegor's castle, with Monkeymagic and his troops providing assistance.

episodes_data.title: Demon Lord, Retry! Season 2 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: The squad of raiders ends up meeting the lord of the castle and the primary target, Archfield Belphegor, and the outcome is less than desirable.

episodes_data.title: Demon Lord, Retry! Season 2 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Organ is in trouble, and it us up to Kunai to save the day.
